Testing Guide¶

This project uses pytest with multiple markers.

Markers¶

  • web → Flask routes

  • buttons → UI behavior

  • analysis → SQL/output formatting

  • data → cleaning and ETL

  • integration → end-to-end tests

Fixtures¶

  • client → Flask test client

  • app → test Flask app factory

Mocking / Test Doubles¶

Tests use: - monkeypatch for replacing scraper - MagicMock for Selenium driver - fake DB connections for isolation

Example:

monkeypatch.setattr(“src.scrape.webdriver.Chrome”, lambda: mock_driver)
